note: Assessed training, dataset redistribution, and model-weight release separately; a license permitting one does not settle the others.

policy.accept: Clear license/permission covers intended use, provenance verifiable, conditions met.
policy.hold: License scope, ownership, attribution, or redistribution rights unclear.
policy.reject: No acceptable permission, or fails project policy.

sources.decision_reason: BSD-3-Clause documentation license clearly covers redistribution and derivative use; pinned versioned HTML archive with verifiable checksum.
sources.download_evidence: Official versioned HTML archive: https://numpy.org/doc/2.5/numpy-html.zip (36,455,676 bytes, last-modified 2026-06-28).
sources.license_evidence: NumPy documentation is published under the BSD 3-Clause license; the docs site carries the full license text on its license page. The numpy/numpy.org LICENSE is BSD-3-Clause.
